Spells:
Aqueous Orb (Bloodline Aquatic3 Conj): R300' 10' diameter sphere of water can be moved 30' per rd and rolled over 10' obstacles for 20 rd; it douses normal fires, acts as Dispel Magic on Large or smaller magical fires, inflicts 2d6 HP nonlethal (save Reflex negates), and engulfs 1 Large, 4 Medium, or 16 Small creatures who fail their saves (save Reflex negates), inflicting an additional 2d6 HP nonlethal each rd
Beast Shape IV (Bloodline Aquatic6 Tran): Self becomes a Tiny (gives +8 Dexterity, -2 Strength, and a +3 natural armor bonus to Armor Class) or Large (gives +6 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, and a +6 natural armor bonus) magical beast for 20 min; the transformation may also give any of a 60' burrow Speed, a 90' climb Speed, 120' fly or swim Speeds, 60' Blindsense, 90' Darkvision, Low-Light Vision, Scent, 60' Tremorsense, a Breath Weapon, Constrict, Ferocity, Grab, Jet, Poison, Pounce, Rake, Ren, Roar, Spikes, Trample, Trip, Web, elemental Resistance 20, and elemental Vulnerability, as appropriate to the form
Control Water (Bloodline Aquatic4 Tran): R1200' Raises or lowers a 200'x200'x40' area of water by 40' for 200 min
Control Water (Raise The Deep4 Tran): R1200' Raises or lowers a 200'x200'x40' area of water by 40' for 200 min
Demand (Aquatic Telepathy8 Ench): Sends to a familiar target a 25-word message that contains a Suggestion (save Will negates); the target can send a 25-word reply
Freedom Of Movement (Deep One4 Abju): Allows touched to ignore movement impediments, escape grapples, and move normally when underwater, (save Will negates) for 200 min
Geyser (Bloodline Aquatic5 Conj): R1200' 5' sq inflicts 3d6 HP fire and up to 10d6 falling (save Reflex half fire only), and the surrounding 50' radius inflicts 1d6 HP fire, for concentration + 1 rd
Greater Planar Ally (Aquatic Telepathy8 Conj): Allows negotiating the purchase of a service from 1-3 extraplanar creatures with a total of up to 18 HD
Hydraulic Push (Bloodline Aquatic1 Evoc): R75' Creates a blast of water that performs a +23 Bull Rush on the target and extinguishes normal fires up to 5'x5'
Seamantle (Bloodline Aquatic8 Conj): 30' high water column around self requires DC 20 + spell level caster level checks for fire spells to take effect and gives self a +8 cover bonus to Armor Class, +4 Reflex, a 30' slam attack that inflicts 1d4 HP bludgeoning, and a touch that extinguishes fires for 20 min
Slipstream (Bloodline Aquatic2 Conj): Creates a wave that moves touched 10' per rd, or 20' per rd downhill, and gives it a +20 swim Speed (save Reflex negates) for 200 min
Suggestion (Aquatic Telepathy3 Ench): R75' Causes the target to follow a reasonable suggestion (save Will negates) for up to 20 hr
Summon Monster VII (Bloodline Aquatic7 Conj): R75' Summons 1 7th-level, 1d3 6th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
World Wave (Bloodline Aquatic9 Tran): Allows self and 20 designated creatures to ride a 20'x200' section of natural terrain that forms a 30' wave for 20 rd or a 5' swell for 20 hr, moves 240' per rd, and inflicts 6d6 (wave) or 1d6 (swell) HP bludgeoning to non-natural objects, with constructs and undead sufferng double
